items.title: How much can org pressure distort a real preference?
items.description: Priya's energy log gave her real evidence: how much people-work energizes her, versus how much she values staying technically deep. That difference is her true lean toward EM. But L2 said org need ("it's the only path up here") should be the last filter, not the first — drag it up and watch how far it can push the decision away from what the energy evidence actually says.
items.compute: const trueLean = params.peopleEnergy - params.depthEnergy; const pressuredDecision = trueLean + params.orgPressure; return { trueLean, pressuredDecision };
